about.title: What is Nostrasia?
about.lead1: Nostrasia is a Nostr conference, and a festival, that started in Japan. First held in 2023, the 2024 and 2025 editions took place in Tokyo.
about.lead2: Nostr is a decentralized protocol that doesn't rely on any particular company or server. The “New to Nostr?” section below shows how it works.

how.label: NOSTR 101
how.title: New to Nostr?
how.lead: Four steps show how a Nostr post reaches its readers.

1.name: Keys
1.title: Make your keys
1.body: First, you create a pair of keys: a secret key <c>nsec</c> and a public key <c>npub</c>. Your npub is the ID that identifies you, and it's fine to share. Your nsec is the secret key only you hold. You don't need to sign up with an email address or anything else.

2.name: Signature
2.title: Sign
2.body: When you write a post (a note), you sign it with your secret key. Thanks to the signature, anyone can check that you really wrote it, wherever it ends up.

3.name: Relays ×3
3.title: Send it to relays
3.body: You send the signed post to several relays. A relay is just a server that stores and passes posts along. Even if one goes down, the same post stays on the others.

4.name: App
4.title: Read it in an app
4.body: An app (client) gathers posts from whichever relays you like and shows them. As long as you have your key, you keep the same account even if you switch apps. You can also send a zap ⚡ (a small amount of bitcoin) to posts you like.
